title: Has anyone built a working Profitable trading Bot?
author: IcyOrdinary8042
selftext:
Hello everyone. Iv been seeing alot of stuff about Trading bots/ trading with Ai ect. So i wanted to ask has anyone here created a working trading bot? As in does the research and trades for you? 

I got no clue how to trade or anything about trading. So is there anyone who doesnt know anything about trading but made a bot that trades for u and actually is profitable?

comments.author: Due_Set_6523
comments.body: if you’re starting from zero, learn the basics and paper trade first. a bot just follows rules. if you don’t understand trading, you can’t tell when those rules are bad, and a bot with bad rules loses money faster than you would by hand. if you try any ai tool later, make sure you can see why it trades, that your funds stay in your account, and that you can stop it anytime

comments.author: Mysterious-Man88
comments.body: For me it’s easy to build a bot that places and manages trades, the hard part is the analysis and finding a strategy that works.

replies.author: IcyOrdinary8042
replies.body: How do u build it?  Is there a way i can build a system that uses demo accounts so i can test and improve it before i give it real cash?

replies.author: Mammoth_Jelly_837
replies.body: Use the chatgpt app on your pc. You can vibe code it

replies.author: IcyOrdinary8042
replies.body: Yeah but i dont have chatGPT subscriptions rn i just was info

replies.author: Mysterious-Man88
replies.body: Yes and I definitely suggest using a paper trading account. I use interactive brokers trader work station. All you have to do is download the Claude desktop app, open up a Claude code session and ask it to build for you. It’s very easy. Claude will tell you want it needs from you
